name: dsh-mcp-bridge
description: Curated, verified MCP server bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, with a connectivity verifier and CI checks.

**面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) 的精选、验证过的 MCP 全家桶插件。**
